capabilities: Embed a vault file as a syntax-highlighted code block via a codefile fence
Limit the embed to a line range or single line
Re-render the block when the source file is saved or renamed
Bake and un-bake code embeds for Obsidian Publish
Configure the extension-to-language map and max file size
extras: Publish does not run community plugins, so codefile blocks render empty on published sites unless baked first; settings search needs Obsidian 1.13+.
problem: Obsidian code embeds require copy-pasting code into fenced blocks, and regular embeds don't render other files as highlighted code that stays in sync with the source.
summary: Embeds a vault file's contents as a syntax-highlighted code block via a codefile fence, with line ranges, live updates, and a Publish baking command.
